notes.name: case_narrative
notes.text: On May 5, 2003, a 54-year-old male was found dead from carbon monoxide poisoning in an automobile in a closed garage. A hose, running into the passenger compartment of the car, was attached to the exhaust pipe. The deceased had been despondent for some time as a result of a malignancy, and letters found in the car indicated intent to take his own life.
